summary: Part 2 (03:55-05:47) of the 2.2 Fulfillment App (KAM) video. Pierre moves from the Fulfillment App O&D Google Sheet (Users tab) to the AppSheet Revibe - Fulfillment App. He shows the Packaging request, SKUs available (with one SKU detail), Shipments, Request products and Inventory exits pages. He describes taking a seller's view from the Users tab, which the narration only partly explains. The last section covers the Return to supplier reason per device and the photo attached to one example return, 010114-081203. All 25 frames were opened and checked. Several narration lines are cut or garbled, so some items are marked unclear or low confidence.

unclear.issue: 'available is way more restricted' is cut off. The narration does not say what is restricted (the SKU list, or the seller view).
'based on {the?} score here' is unclear. No 'score' element is visible on the Shipments page, so the word may be wrong.

'user table that i just showed you she is not loading' is unclear. The Users table is on the Google Sheet tab, which was shown loaded at 03:58 (t00238) and 04:48 (t00288). The AppSheet tab is blank at 04:40 (t00280). It is not clear which table or view the trainer means.

Row 2 of the Users sheet changes from Role 'SteppingStone' / Type 'Supplier' to Role 'Superadmin' / Type 'Superadmin' during the walkthrough, with no narration about it. It is not clear whether this is a demo step or the intended way to switch a view.
'during interviews i mean during not interviews' is garbled. The next line says 'meetings with sellers', so the word 'interviews' is most likely a slip.
'reasons why we rejected some devices' does not map directly to the screen. Inventory exits shows 'Reason for return'; 'Rejected' is a Request products status, a different concept.
'we can see camera dots' is not clearly visible in the frame. The full-size photo (t00340) shows an iPhone camera app screen and no clearly visible camera dot.
The price-based-on-buy-box sentence is cut off after 'and thus' at 04:13, so the full rule (for example whether the price is always the supplier's buy box) cannot be confirmed.
The trainer points at Supplier inventory (t00266) but no Supplier inventory page is shown in any frame, so its content is not in the evidence.
